title: Argo Workflows LoopRuntime wrapper values schema
description: Plan 2026-05-20 T2.5 ext — fail-fast on Argo Workflows build cluster config drift. Protects controller scale (workflowWorkers/podWorkers under 50+ concurrent build load), images.cloneRunner SHA pin (supply chain), sourceBucket (S3 build artifact location).

cloneRunner.description: Clone-runner image (LoopRuntime custom). MUST be registry+repo+tag format. Empty/garbage = workflow can't start init container.

sourceBucket.description: S3 bucket name (LoopRuntime SOURCE_BUCKET). MUST match Pulumi-created bucket + loop-runtime-api env var. RFC 1123: lowercase + dashes, no leading/trailing dash.

runAsNonRoot.description: INF-G08: controller MUST run as non-root.

workflowWorkers.description: Max concurrent workflow reconciliations. Default 32 sized for 50+ concurrent builds. <1 = no progress. >128 = controller OOM risk.

podWorkers.description: Max concurrent pod reconciliations. Default 32. Same bounds as workflowWorkers.

port.description: Metrics port. <1024 = privileged port (would fail non-root). Default 9090.

path.description: Metrics HTTP path — MUST start with /.

server.description: Argo Workflows UI server pass-through (typically disabled in build cluster — UI is admin tool).
